check_1016.note: No pick, no ideas. Scan by Alpaca IEX snapshots of 129 large caps and 11 ETFs at 10:16 (140 of 141 with a bar today; no Webull in this session). The tape has steadied after the gap: SPY gapped -2.2% and is -0.4% from its open, QQQ -3.3% / -0.7%, SMH -5.8% / -0.8%, IGV -3.2% / -0.4%, IWM -1.5% / -0.5%; XLE +1.0% from its open, XLP and TLT flat. Biggest mover: DE +7.3% from its open (gap -5.0%, 0.9% under its high), the reaction to this morning's report, so inside the report window (R3); ADI +4.4% (day after its report, R3), WDAY +3.4% and DELL +2.2% (reported last night, R3, and Dell has only target changes at 09:32). TEAM +2.3% and IBM +2.1% move with the software bounce and carry no headline since 09:30: relative strength with nothing behind it. Energy leads the sectors (XOM, CVX, COP, OXY, SLB +1.3% to +1.9% from the open) on oil's pre-market rise, a cause from before the open, and XOM and CVX sit within 0.25% of their highs (T3); the only in-session energy headline is a Chevron methane probe, against the move. On the put side the chip and hardware names extend their gaps (LRCX -3.8%, INTC -3.7%, COHR -3.3%, ORCL -3.3%) and cybersecurity slips (ZS -2.9%, CRWD -2.7%, both at the day's low), MRNA -3.8% near its low: no in-session headline on any of them in the Alpaca feed or LATEST.md, the AI selling is the pre-market cause (R1, R2), and most are at the day's low (T3). The Alpaca news feed has three headlines on these names since 09:00 (Oracle Commodity royalty, not Oracle; the Chevron probe; Dell target changes). Nothing has a cause still unfolding with the tape behind it, so the list stays empty (T6).
check_1016.note_zh: 不选股，也不列想法。大盘低开 2% 后基本稳住，涨得最多的迪尔（比开盘涨 7%）、ADI、Workday、戴尔都是刚公布财报，按规则不碰。能源股跟着油价涨，但原因在开盘前就有了，而且贴着当天最高点；芯片、网络安全股继续跌，同样没有开盘后的新消息，又贴着最低点，所以都不列。
